dry_heat.reason: These are warming/heating herbs that conflict with the moisten+cool direction of dry_heat

dry_cold.reason: These are overly drying herbs that conflict with the moisten+warm direction of dry_cold

overcharged.reason: These are stimulating/heating herbs that conflict with the cool+settle direction of overcharged

rules.conflictCheck: Before adding any secondary herb, check if its name (lowercase) is in PRIMARY_CONFLICTS[primary_pattern].blockedHerbs. If so, omit and document.
rules.documentation: Document each omission and addition in debug_trace
